svg.title: Workplace Assistant agent architecture
svg.text: ADK app 'app' · plugins: MemoryBankPlugin (saves every turn)
routes · small talk · refuses out of scope
Every agent: PreloadMemoryTool recalls the employee's facts at the start of a turn; after_tool_callback writes a workplace.tool_blocked
audit event when a call is refused. The employee's email travels to the MCP servers in the X-User-Email header, set from the session, never by the model.
